# Storage Dashboard Screens
12 minute read.

[Last Modified 2026-08-24 13:16 EDT](https://github.com/truenas/documentation/commit/6c6f036b550c1c5d20cf90a4be5ef86824a60884)

## Storage Dashboard Widgets [Anchor to: Storage Dashboard Widgets](https://www.truenas.com/docs/scale/storage/storagedashboardscreens/#storage-dashboard-widgets)
### VDEVs Widget [Anchor to: VDEVs Widget](https://www.truenas.com/docs/scale/storage/storagedashboardscreens/#vdevs-widget)
#### Status Indicators [Anchor to: Status Indicators](https://www.truenas.com/docs/scale/storage/storagedashboardscreens/#status-indicators)
- Green circle with checkmark for a **Healthy**
- Red circle with an x for **Pool is not Healthy**

### Usage Widget [Anchor to: Usage Widget](https://www.truenas.com/docs/scale/storage/storagedashboardscreens/#usage-widget)
The **Usage** widget shows information on the pool space datasets consumed and the status of pool usage.

The widget includes a color-coded donut chart that illustrates the percentage of space the pool uses. Blue indicates space usage in the 0-80% range, and red indicates anything above 80%. A warning message displays below the donut graph when usage exceeds 80%.

**Usable Capacity** details pool space statistics by **Used** and **Available**.

### Storage Health Widget [Anchor to: Storage Health Widget](https://www.truenas.com/docs/scale/storage/storagedashboardscreens/#storage-health-widget)
The **Storage Health** widget shows health-of-the-pool information.

- Pool status shows the pool status as** Online, no errors** or **Offline**, **Degraded no errors**.

### Disk Health Widget [Anchor to: Disk Health Widget](https://www.truenas.com/docs/scale/storage/storagedashboardscreens/#disk-health-widget)
The **Disk Health** widget shows information on the health of the disks in a pool.

## Description [​](https://developer.semrush.com/intergalactic/data-display/donut-chart/donut-chart#description)
**Donut chart** shows parts of a whole by dividing a circle into proportional segments. Each segment represents a fraction, and the entire circle represents the total sum, always equaling 100%.

**Key points for using donut chart:**

- It can only show a few values clearly. With more values, segments become too small to be effective.
- Donut chart needs more space than, for instance, [Bar chart](https://developer.semrush.com/intergalactic/data-display/bar-chart/bar-chart).

## Tooltip [​](https://developer.semrush.com/intergalactic/data-display/donut-chart/donut-chart#tooltip)
Display name and value in tooltips.

![](https://developer.semrush.com/intergalactic/assets/donut-hover-big.CiMkH12Z.png)

![](data:image/png;base64,)

## Initial data loading [​](https://developer.semrush.com/intergalactic/data-display/donut-chart/donut-chart#initial-data-loading)
![](data:image/png;base64,)

## Usage in UX/UI [​](https://developer.semrush.com/intergalactic/data-display/donut-chart/donut-chart#usage-in-ux-ui)
TIP

**It isn’t recommended to display more than five categories on the donut chart**. If there are more than five categories, display the largest five, and place the others in the "Other" category.

Use [Stacked bar chart](https://developer.semrush.com/intergalactic/data-display/bar-chart/bar-chart) instead.

![](https://developer.semrush.com/intergalactic/assets/donut-yes-no.D0Sba9OR.png)
